svalbard: Svalbard is a Norwegian archipelago in the Arctic Ocean.
svante august arrhenius: Svante August Arrhenius is Swedish chemist and physicist noted for his theory of chemical dissociation.
Svante August Arrhenius means the same as Arrhenius.
svedberg: Svedberg means the same as Swedenborg or Emanuel Swedenborg or Emanuel Svedberg.
svengali: Svengali is someone who tries to persuade or force another person to do his bidding.
Svengali can also mean the musician in a novel by George du Maurier who controls Trilby's singing hypnotically.
sverdrup: Sverdrup is Norwegian explorer who led expeditions into the Arctic.
Sverdrup means the same as Otto Neumann Sverdrup.
sverige: Sverige is a Scandinavian kingdom in the eastern part of the Scandinavian Peninsula.
Sverige means the same as Sweden or Kingdom of Sweden.
svizzera: Svizzera is a landlocked federal republic in central Europe.
Svizzera means the same as Switzerland or Swiss Confederation or Suisse.
svr: SVR is Russia's intelligence service responsible for foreign operations, intelligence-gathering and analysis, and the exchange of intelligence information.
SVR means the same as Foreign Intelligence Service or Sluzhba Vneshney Razvedki.
svelte: Svelte means being of delicate or slender build.
Svelte means the same as slender or slight or slim.
